claudeSoundAlerts.enabled.description: Enable the local listener and sound alerts.

claudeSoundAlerts.serverPort.description: Starting localhost port for dynamic listeners. Each VS Code window automatically uses the first free port from this value upward.

claudeSoundAlerts.listenerPortCount.description: Number of localhost ports available for simultaneous VS Code listener instances. Each window automatically picks a free port.

claudeSoundAlerts.debounceMs.description: Suppress duplicate alerts of the same type inside this time window.

claudeSoundAlerts.showVisualNotification.description: Also show a VS Code information notification when an alert fires.

enumDescriptions: Recommended: use authoritative task data when available and compatibility mode until a session proves it supports the registry.
Require completion-registry evidence; unverified Stop events never become Finished.
Compatibility mode: a Stop can become a Finished candidate even without registry data.
claudeSoundAlerts.completionVerification.description: How Main Work Finished behaves when Claude omits background-task registry fields.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedGraceMs.description: Delay a Finished candidate before playing it. Any newer same-session activity received during this grace window cancels the candidate, including queued background-task wakeups.

claudeSoundAlerts.textHeuristicDowngrade.description: Downgrade a Finished candidate only when Claude's closing text contains a high-confidence indication that work is still running or will report later. User-directed waits and negated phrases are excluded. This rule can only suppress Finished; it can never create one.

claudeSoundAlerts.backgroundAlertMode.description: When to play Background / Waiting within one background-work chain: only when entering waiting, when the blocking task set changes, or on every pending Stop.

claudeSoundAlerts.ignoredBackgroundTaskT.description: Background task types treated as ambient/non-blocking for final-completion detection. Terminal-status entries are always ignored. Add teammate only if you explicitly want idle/running teammates not to block Finished.

claudeSoundAlerts.teammateIdleCountFallb.description: Experimental: when Claude does not provide a reliable teammate id/name correlation, allow a same-turn TeammateIdle count to suppress otherwise-unmatched teammate background entries. Off by default because a stale idle observation could otherwise cause a false Finished alert.

claudeSoundAlerts.recurringCronsCountAsP.description: When enabled, recurring session crons such as /loop are treated as Background / Waiting. When off, recurring iterations are classified separately and never count as Main Work Finished.

claudeSoundAlerts.strictCompletionVerifi.description: Legacy v1.7.0 completion-verification setting retained for migration compatibility.
claudeSoundAlerts.strictCompletionVerifi.deprecationMessage: Deprecated in v1.7.1. Use Claude Sound Alerts: Completion Verification Mode instead.

claudeSoundAlerts.eventSettings.description: Per-event alert settings managed by the Claude Sound Alerts control panel.

claudeSoundAlerts.watchedFiles.description: Literal filenames to watch for Claude Code FileChanged alerts, for example .env or package.json. Installed hooks are updated automatically when this changes.

claudeSoundAlerts.repeatGapMs.description: Pause in milliseconds between repeated alert sounds.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Alerts work, but workspace-affinity routing is limited when folders are not local file-system paths.
